issue.body:
One of the recent updates to the logger breaks the whole app (including default Yii advanced app). On debugging, the following line in config (main.php) for the `log` component is the cause for the error.

``` php
'traceLevel' => YII_DEBUG ? 3 : 0,
```

Commenting this line makes the app work... but I am not sure where the `traceLevel` validation will then need to be included.
